title: fix(skills-ratchet): price the release stamp's prerelease segment at stable width
body:
Fixes #23176
Clause-②: no (an internal repo gate; no published accept set or public surface)

## The maintainer ruling this lands on

This PR moves the skills token ratchet in the direction its own refusal marks ⛔ MAINTAINER-ONLY: "The other direction lands only in a PR whose body quotes a maintainer ruling authorizing it." The maintainer chose route A on decision record 6138951701 (comment `6138951701` on #23176). The choice, verbatim:

> 「A 剥预发布后缀 (Recommended)」

Route A as that decision record defines it, verbatim:

> 门禁计数前,把 frontmatter `version:` 值里的预发布后缀(`-next.N`)剥掉,按正式版宽度计 | `scripts/check-skills-token-ratchet.mjs` 加自测行;非受管面,普通合并队列 | … | 预发布树上少计 7 字节;`main` 的读数不变,上限一个不动

## What changed

One file: `scripts/check-skills-token-ratchet.mjs` (+122 / -6).

- **`pricedTokens(text, { stamped })`** is now the count the gate judges. It is `countTokens` minus the semver prerelease segment of the frontmatter `metadata.version` stamp, and the minus applies only to files the version script stamps. `countTokens` and `TOKEN_CONVENTION` are unchanged.
- **`stampPrerelease(text)`** reads the stamp with `extractMetadataVersion` from `scripts/check-skill-compatibility-version.mjs`, the script whose `--fix` writes the stamp. The stamped set is that script's `stampedSkillPaths()`. There is no second parser. A version carrying build metadata matches nothing, so nothing is excluded for it.
- **The output says when it excludes something.** The file's line gains one sentence: "The `-next.0` prerelease segment of its metadata.version stamp (7 bytes) is not priced." On a stable tree that note is empty, so `main`'s output does not change.
- **Header.** A new "ONE EXCLUSION" paragraph quotes the ruling and states the boundary. The "INDEPENDENTLY REPRODUCIBLE" bullet now gives the hand audit for a prerelease tree: `ceil((bytes - N) / 4)`, where `bytes` is the file's `wc -c` and N is the byte length of the segment after the stamp's patch number (`-next.0` is 7, `-next.12` is 8, a stable stamp is 0). The rest of the counting convention is unchanged.
- **Not touched:** no `CEILINGS` row (not one number changed); no `skills/**`, `.github/workflows/**` or other governed path; nothing on `changeset-release/main` / #21988.

**Why the fix belongs in this gate and not in the producer.** The root `version` script runs `check-skill-compatibility-version.mjs --fix` after `changeset version`, and that writes the stamp from `@objectstack/spec`'s version. The same script's check reds on any other value. So `18.0.0-next.0` is the correct stamp, and the defect was this gate counting it as authored text. An author cannot use the exclusion to buy room, for two reasons: only that one segment is excluded, and its length is fixed by a stamp another gate holds equal to the spec version.

## Measurements (head `f06e7f636`)

| tree | script | `objectstack-automation/SKILL.md` | `objectstack-data/SKILL.md` | gate exit |
|:--|:--|:--|:--|:--|
| `main` `e540e7ffb` | before this PR | 5784 / 5785 | 6128 / 6128 | 0 |
| `main` + this PR | after | 5784 / 5785 | 6128 / 6128 | 0. Full output byte-identical to before (135 lines, `diff` empty) |
| #21988 `63eb607ad1` (the card's tree) | the tree's own | 5786 / 5785 ✗ | 6129 / 6128 ✗ | 1, matching the card |
| #21988 `63eb607ad1` | this PR's script overlaid | 5784 / 5785 | 6128 / 6128 | 0. Step 37 (`--self-test`, then the gate) both exit 0, 76 cases pass |
| #21988 `8826e954d` (the PR's current head) | the tree's own | 5786 / 5785 ✗ | 6129 / 6128 ✗ | 1 |
| #21988 `8826e954d` | this PR's script overlaid | 5784 / 5785 | 6128 / 6128 | 0. Step 37 both exit 0. The per-file token list is identical to `main`'s |

- The overlaid copy is byte-identical to this PR's blob (`48e6aadbb`) on both trees. The two modules it imports are byte-identical to `main`'s on `8826e954d`.
- **Authored growth still reds.** I appended +4 bytes to `objectstack-data/SKILL.md`, the smallest growth that crosses its ceiling on `main`, since that file carries 3 bytes of sub-token slack. That gives 6129 / 6128 and exit 1, both on a scratch copy of `main` (stamp `17.7.0`) and on `8826e954d` (stamp `18.0.0-next.0`). The file was restored afterwards and the hash compared.
- **A two-digit counter is handled.** Re-stamping that file `18.0.0-next.12` on `8826e954d` gives 6128 / 6128, green, with an 8-byte segment excluded.

## Self-test: 11 rows added (65 to 76 cases; roster floor 64 to 75)

- the stamp's prerelease segment is read off metadata.version
- a zero-headroom SKILL.md stamped -next.0 is green: the stamp prices at stable width
- priced whole, that same file is red (the row above is not vacuous)
- one authored byte over a zero-headroom ceiling is red under a stable stamp
- one authored byte over is red under a prerelease stamp too: the strip buys an author nothing
- a multi-digit prerelease (-next.12) prices the same as a stable stamp
- a stable stamp prices byte-for-byte as countTokens
- every real bundle file without a prerelease stamp prices exactly as countTokens
- a prerelease-shaped string outside the stamp is priced
- a file the version script does not stamp is priced whole
- the stamped set is the version script's: exactly the real SKILL.md files

The fixtures are padded so the stable spelling has zero byte slack. The "one authored byte over" pair is what proves the padding is right.

## Gates

- `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands --repo objectstack-ai/objectstack` derived 31 commands at `f06e7f636`. All 31 exit 0, and `--ran` reconciles 31 derived, 31 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED. That includes `pnpm check:pm-dispatch-gates` (the fast tier, 410.9 s), `pnpm check:nul-bytes`, `pnpm check:entry-guard` and both ratchet commands.
- `pnpm check:ratchet-remedy-authority`: OK. 275 scripts swept: 14 mark the expanding remedy, 5 turn it down, 256 hand out none. That is the same classification as on base `e540e7ffb`. The control corpus, which pins this gate as `marked`, passes set-equality both ways. The change adds no loosening remedy.
- Lint, narrowed and evidenced: `eslint --no-inline-config --format json scripts/check-skills-token-ratchet.mjs` linted 1 file with 0 errors and 0 warnings. `--print-config` for the file shows `parserOptions` `{ecmaVersion, sourceType}` and no `project`/`projectService`. Type-aware linting is off, so this diff cannot change any untouched file's verdict. CI runs the full `pnpm lint`.

## Changeset

None; `skip-changeset`. The root package is `private: true`, and `scripts/` is in no package's `files[]`.

## Acceptance notes

- `TOKEN_CONVENTION` (the price-tag header string) is deliberately unchanged. It names the convention the ceilings are pinned in. The exclusion is named on the line of each file it touches, and only on a tree where it applies.
- On the older `63eb607ad1` tree, one generator-owned file (`objectstack-automation/references/_index.md`) reads 816 against `main`'s 886. That is a difference between the two bases. The file is not ratcheted and is out of scope here; on the current head `8826e954d` the list matches `main`.
